Use the provided Riven empowered-state reference
for Riven throughout the entire video.

Keep the same woman,
appearance,
hair,

injuries,

Riven already holds

Use the provided empowered weapon reference.

Keep the same weapon design throughout:
dark physical metal at the core,
bright emerald runes,
and translucent emerald-green energy
forming the larger blade silhouette.

The empowered weapon is already active
when the video begins.


Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the opponent.

Keep the same mysterious humanoid dark figure.

Its form is made from unstable shadow-like darkness
that naturally blends with smoke.

Keep its silhouette mysterious and indistinct.


Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the location.


Use the provided battlefield image
as an additional environment reference.

Match the broad dirt road,
burning wooden buildings,
dense smoke,
orange firelight,
distant mountains,
and overall battlefield scale shown in that image.

Use this image only to understand
the location,
atmosphere,
and spatial scale.

Do not copy the character positions
or action shown in that image.


=== STARTING STATE ===

Riven stands on the broad road
inside the burning settlement.

Her emerald-green empowered weapon
is fully active.

She is injured,
exhausted,
and breathing heavily,
but remains ready to fight.

Far ahead stands
the Mysterious Dark Figure.

The figure has already been wounded.

Its unstable dark form
has mostly reformed,
but black smoke still escapes from it.

A large amount of dark smoke
and shadow energy
is beginning to gather around the figure.

There is clear fighting distance
between Riven and the figure.

Both remain still
for a brief moment.

Then the dark figure
begins gathering its full power.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

This is the most intense battle
of the film.

Fast,
powerful,
but visually readable combat.

Strong physical weight and impact.

Dynamic cinematic camera movement
without chaotic editing.

Riven fights with grounded,
physical sword movement.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
moves with unnatural supernatural speed,
sometimes becoming a dark blur
through smoke.

Emerald-green wind and runic energy
belong to Riven.

Black smoke-like shadow energy
belongs to the dark figure.

Keep both powers
clearly distinguishable.

Natural fire,
wind,
heavy breathing,
footsteps,
weapon impacts,
energy impacts,
wood breaking,
and environmental sound.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Only one dialogue line from Riven.

Use THREE major cinematic phases.


=== PHASE 1 — THE SHADOW UNLEASHED ===

Begin from a low cinematic angle
near the burning road.

Smoke moves unnaturally
across the ground.

Reveal Riven
with the glowing emerald weapon.

Across the road,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
stands inside gathering darkness.


Dark smoke from the surrounding area
begins rushing toward the figure.

The darkness becomes denser.

Then—

the figure unleashes its power.


Black smoke-like energy
surges violently across the road.


Several fast-moving shadow forms
emerge from the darkness
and rush toward Riven.


They are not separate creatures.

They are unstable extensions
of the same shadow energy.


Riven immediately reacts.


A dark attack
sweeps toward her.

She avoids it.


Another comes from the side.

Riven turns—

BLOCK.


The emerald blade
collides with the darkness.


A sharp burst
of green and black energy.


Another shadow attack approaches.


Riven swings.


SLASH.


The empowered blade
cuts through the dark form,

breaking it apart into smoke.


Suddenly—

the real Mysterious Dark Figure
rushes through the surrounding darkness
at unnatural speed.


Riven barely reacts in time.


HEAVY CLASH.


The dark figure
strikes against
the empowered blade.


Black darkness
and emerald energy
explode outward from the impact.


Riven is driven backward,

but remains on her feet.


The dark figure
immediately disappears
back into the moving smoke.


Riven searches
through the darkness around her.


=== PHASE 2 — RIVEN FIGHTS BACK ===

More shadow forms
move through the smoke
around Riven.


Riven stops retreating.


She steadies her breathing.


She watches carefully.


Several unstable dark silhouettes
appear around her.


They resemble
the Mysterious Dark Figure.


The silhouettes
begin closing in.


Riven remains still.


She grips the empowered weapon
with both hands.


The dark forms rush toward her.


At the final moment—


Riven releases
a powerful short burst
of emerald wind energy.


GREEN SHOCKWAVE.


The false dark forms
are torn apart
and dissolve into smoke.


The surrounding darkness clears
for a brief moment.


Only one figure remains.


The real Mysterious Dark Figure.


Riven sees it.


She immediately rushes forward.


The dark figure
rushes toward her.


CLASH.


Riven blocks the first attack.


She turns with the momentum
and immediately counters.


One powerful swing.


DIRECT HIT.


The emerald blade
cuts through
the dark figure's unstable form.


Black smoke
tears violently away from its body.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
is thrown backward
across the burning road.


It lands farther away
and struggles to reform.


Its silhouette flickers.


Dark smoke escapes
from the damaged area.


Riven stops.


She is breathing heavily.


The emerald weapon
remains bright in her hands.


A brief silence.


Riven watches
the wounded figure
trying to reform.


Her expression becomes cold
and deeply personal.


She looks directly at it.


Riven says quietly:


"You took enough from me."


Silence.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
stops moving.


Then—


the surrounding smoke
begins violently moving
toward it again.


Much faster than before.


=== PHASE 3 — FINAL CLASH ===

The dark figure
begins pulling
all nearby darkness toward itself.


Black smoke races
across the ground.


Smoke from the burning structures
is dragged toward the figure.


The darkness gathers
into a violent mass
around its humanoid silhouette.


The figure remains
the same mysterious entity.

Its shape does not become
a different monster.


Across the road,

Riven sees
the enormous darkness gathering.


She is exhausted,

but remains standing.


Riven grips
the empowered weapon
with both hands.


The emerald runes
grow brighter.


Green energy intensifies
around the blade.


Wind begins gathering
around Riven.


Ash and embers
lift from the road.


Her blonde hair
and clothing move
in the growing wind.


Emerald wind energy
spirals around
the massive blade.


The weapon reaches
its brightest state.


A brief stillness.


At one end of the road—

a violent mass
of black shadow energy.


At the other—

Riven surrounded
by emerald wind.


Then—


the Mysterious Dark Figure
launches forward.


It rushes directly toward Riven
inside a massive wave
of darkness.


The dark wave
tears down the road.


Riven holds her ground.


She waits.


The darkness
rapidly closes the distance.


At the final moment—


Riven steps forward.


She turns her entire body
into one powerful sword swing.


WIND SLASH.


The empowered blade
releases a massive
crescent-shaped wave
of emerald-green wind
and runic energy.


The green Wind Slash
flies directly
toward the incoming darkness.


IMPACT.


The emerald Wind Slash
collides with
the massive dark wave.


Green wind
and black shadow energy
struggle against each other.


For one brief moment,

the collision holds.


Then—


the emerald Wind Slash
begins cutting
through the darkness.


The black wave splits apart.


Emerald energy
breaks through the center.


The Wind Slash
continues forward—


directly through
the Mysterious Dark Figure.


Sudden silence.


The dark figure stops.


Its unstable silhouette
remains standing
for one brief moment.


Thin emerald energy
appears through
its dark form.


Then—

the silhouette
begins losing its shape.


Black smoke separates
from the body.


The remaining emerald wind
pulls the darkness apart.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
gradually dissolves
into smoke and dark particles.


Its silhouette disappears completely.


Nothing physical remains.


The unnatural darkness
around the battlefield
disappears with it.


The wind settles.


The battlefield becomes quiet.


Riven remains standing
alone on the burning road.


She is completely exhausted.


Her breathing is heavy.


The empowered emerald weapon
is still active in her hands.


Its green energy
remains visible.


Riven looks toward
the empty place
where the dark figure disappeared.


Nothing returns.


Only normal smoke,
fire,
embers,
and wind remain.


Hold on Riven
for a quiet moment.


CUT.


=== FINAL STATE ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure
has been completely defeated.

It is completely gone.

No dark silhouette remains.

No supernatural shadow attack remains.

The battle is over.

Riven is still standing
on the burning settlement road.

She is badly exhausted
but conscious.

She still holds
the glowing emerald empowered weapon.

The emerald energy
has not faded yet.

There are no further attacks.

No civilians enter yet.

End in quiet aftermath.

CUT.

the figure unleashes its power.

the same mysterious entity.

a different monster.

Riven sees
the enormous darkness gathering.

but remains standing.


Riven grips
the empowered weapon
with both hands.

grow brighter.


Green energy intensifies
around the blade.


Wind begins gathering
around Riven.

lift from the road.


Her blonde hair
and clothing move
in the growing wind.


Emerald wind energy
spirals around
the massive blade.


The weapon reaches

a violent mass
of black shadow energy.


At the other—

Riven surrounded
by emerald wind.

the Mysterious Dark Figure
launches forward.

inside a massive wave
of darkness.


The dark wave
tears down the road.


Riven holds her ground.

The darkness
rapidly closes the distance.

Riven steps forward.

crescent-shaped wave

flies directly
toward the incoming darkness.

collides with
the massive dark wave.


Green wind
and black shadow energy
struggle against each other.

the collision holds.


Then—


the emerald Wind Slash
begins cutting
through the darkness.


The black wave splits apart.


Emerald energy
breaks through the center.


The Wind Slash
continues forward—


directly through
the Mysterious Dark Figure.


Sudden silence.


The dark figure stops.


Its unstable silhouette
remains standing
for one brief moment.


Thin emerald energy
appears through
its dark form.


Then—

the silhouette
begins losing its shape.


Black smoke separates
from the body.


The remaining emerald wind
pulls the darkness apart.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
gradually dissolves
into smoke and dark particles.


Its silhouette disappears completely.


Nothing physical remains.


The unnatural darkness
around the battlefield
disappears with it.


The wind settles.


The battlefield becomes quiet.


Riven remains standing
alone on the burning road.


She is completely exhausted.


Her breathing is heavy.


The empowered emerald weapon
is still active in her hands.


Its green energy
remains visible.


Riven looks toward
the empty place
where the dark figure disappeared.


Nothing returns.


Only normal smoke,
fire,
embers,
and wind remain.


Hold on Riven
for a quiet moment.


CUT.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
has been completely defeated.

It is completely gone.

No dark silhouette remains.

No supernatural shadow attack remains.

The battle is over.

Riven is still standing
on the burning settlement road.

She is badly exhausted
but conscious.

She still holds
the glowing emerald empowered weapon.

The emerald energy
has not faded yet.

There are no further attacks.

No civilians enter yet.

End in quiet aftermath.

CUT.
